full-build.description: Prefer an exact pinned public-source Bake recipe when maintained; mirror images without one.

platform.description: Mirror official public linux/amd64 manifests and build only Atum compatibility images.

consumers: Big Bang Vault server and agent

renderedBaseline.normalization: The baseline records Harbor-qualified runtime targets after Big Bang and prep overrides. Controller-generated and configuration-only images remain required inventory entries but are not required in a direct Helm render.

legacyCrosswalk.strategy: Preserve each enabled Big Bang or prep chart runtime contract. Mirror the exact official public image when Big Bang uses its publisher-native contract; build an Atum replacement whenever Big Bang selects a Bitnami variant or otherwise requires compatibility content. Iron Bank references are comparison metadata only and are never pulled.

consumers: Big Bang Vault server and agent
